win_system.notes: Ways with xWays/xSplit; avalanches unlock Enhancer Cells L→R.

cascades_or_tumbles.how_it_works: Winning combos explode; new symbols fall. Each win unlocks an Enhancer Cell L→R on bottom of middle 4 reels. Avasplit may +1 size on remaining symbols.

other.name: Enhancer Cells
other.how_it_works: Locked under middle 4 reels; unlock L→R on wins; each reveals a symbol; removed → new on next avalanche.

other.name: Demon
other.how_it_works: Removes random count of size-1 symbols then becomes paying symbol with mult = removed count (or 1× if none). Triggers after wins removed.

other.name: xNudge® Wild
other.how_it_works: Nudges fully; +1 mult/nudge; absorbs nudged-over mults; will not nudge onto locked Enhancers; can inherit Hellevator mult.

other.name: Hellevator Booster
other.how_it_works: Persists in bonus; reveals random symbol; immune to Demon; stored mult carries across round.

wilds.name: Wild / xNudge® Wild
wilds.behavior: Any reel; xNudge fills reel + mult.

scatters.name: Scatter / Hellevator Booster
scatters.behavior: 3 Scatter or Hellevator in base → 8 Hell Spins. In bonus, 3 collected Scatters → +2 spins + another Hellevator.

specials.name: Avasplit Effect
specials.behavior: After explode, some remaining symbols +1 size.

specials.name: Max Win symbol
specials.behavior: God Mode: land on Enhancer for max chase at 3,800×.

base_game_loop.summary: 6×4 avalanche ways; unlock Enhancers; Demon/xNudge/xWays/xSplit. 3 Scatter/Hellevator → 8 Hell Spins with sticky Hellevator + scatter meter. xBet 2.4×, Bonus Hunt 15×, God Mode 3,800×. Extra Spin after Hell. Cap 20,066×.

phases.name: Avalanche loop
phases.what_happens: Wins explode; unlock Enhancers; Avasplit; Demon; xNudge.

phases.name: Bonus check
phases.what_happens: 3 Scatter/Hellevator → Hell Spins; optional Extra Spin.

modes.name: Hell Spins
modes.trigger: 3 Scatter or Hellevator Booster in base.
modes.retrigger: Collect 3 Scatters in bonus → +2 spins + Hellevator added.
modes.sticky_or_persistent_state: Hellevator persists; stored mult carries; Enhancer symbols reset each spin.
modes.end_condition: Spins done or 20,066×; optional Extra Spin keeps Hellevator mults if cost ≤ prior win.

phases.name: Enter
phases.what_happens: 8 Hell Spins; Hellevator sticky if landed.

bonus_free_spins.notes: xTra Extra Spin priced from Hellevator mults.

features.name: God Mode
features.effects: Chase max via Max Win on Enhancer.

features.name: Extra Spin (xTra)
features.cost_text: Based on Hellevator mults (≤ prior win)
features.effects: One more spin keeping Hellevator mults.

ante_bet.notes: Cost is 2.4× total stake style booster.

evidence.quote_or_excerpt: 6×4 avalanche; Enhancer Cells; Demon; Hell Spins 8 from 3 Scatter/Hellevator; xBet 2.4×; Bonus Hunt 15×; God Mode 3800×; max 20,066×.
